BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS:  IMSc   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: FOOD TECHNOLOGY  SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: FT211 FRUITS & VEGETABLE PROCESSING TECHNOLOGY
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Distinguish between ‘Climatic and non-climatic fruits’. [2] 1 4
Q.1(b) Classify the vegetables and give the chemical composition of potato. [3] 3 4


Q.2(a) Describe the fruits maturity with suitable examples.  [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Explain the Nitrogen-containing substances and Organic acids that are found in fruits. [3] 3 2


Q.3(a) Summarize the causes of post-harvest losses of fruits and vegetables. [2] 1 2
Q.3(b) Draw a neat and clean diagram of the fruit parenchyma cell and tag their different parts. [3] 2 4


Q.4(a) Explain the Biological changes (Microbiological Macro biological) that occurs in the fruits
and vegetables.
[2] 5 2
Q.4(b) Clarify that the Fruits and vegetables are living products with suitable examples. [3] 2 4


Q.5(a) Write about different types of senescence. [2] 2 6
Q.5(b) Illustrate the process of respiration in fruits and vegetables.  [3] 5 3
